update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval for this backend's own charts, in seconds. It does not change how often the BMC is polled.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often to retry the initial connection when the job fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: Controls how much log data this backend keeps.

max_size.title: Maximum retained size
max_size.description: Size the stored log data is trimmed back to, for example `10GB`. Must be positive.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define the Virtual Node in `vnodes.conf` first, then enter its name here.
